name: double_eq
prelude:
def double : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => 0
  | n + 1 => double n + 2
statement: theorem double_eq (n : Nat) : double n = 2 * n
proofs:
induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => simp [double, Nat.mul_add, ih]
  have additive (a b : Nat) : double (a + b) = double a + double b := by
    induction b with
    | zero => simp [double]
    | succ b ih => simp [double, ih, Nat.add_assoc]
  have diagonal (k : Nat) : double k = k + k := by
    induction k with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ k ih => rw [additive, ih]; simp [double]; omega
  rw [diagonal]
  omega
strategies: Induction on n using multiplication distributivity.
Prove additivity, then use it to establish the diagonal identity double k = k + k.
